newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC DOUBLE SPARKS CROATIA WIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC DOUBLE SPARKS CROATIA WIN.

text.p: Goran Ivanisevic wrapped up a personal victory double as Croatia completed their win over the Czech Republic at the World Team Cup on Wednesday.

World number four Ivanisevic, who gave Croatia a 1-0 lead by beating Bohdan Ulihrach in his singles on Tuesday, joined Sasa Hirszon to beat Daniel Vacek and Martin Damm 5-7 6-4 6-3 in a rain-hit doubles match that took two days to finish.

With Croatia leading 3-1 in the third set, and the tie level 1-1, Tuesday's play was halted by bad light and barely completed on Wednesday before torrential rain disrupted the event for the second consecutive day.
Scheduled play Wednesday has Croatia taking on the United States, and Australia meeting the Czech Republic in the other tie.

World number one Pete Sampras, who retired from his opening match against Australia's Mark Philippoussis on Monday after straining a left thigh muscle, was ruled out of the tie with Croatia and replaced by doubles specialist Alex O'Brien.
Sampras, playing in only his third event after missing two tournaments with a wrist injury, is to remain in Germany and said he hopes to play on Friday.

After first-round losses in Monte Carlo and the Italian Open, Sampras is desperate to get in some clay-court competition ahead of the French Open, the only Grand Slam title to elude him, which begins next Monday.
